B13.rule: B-13 B13: per AOI with both classes, AUC and PR-AUC of M3n minus M1c, and the Brier skill increment relative to the AOI's own flooded share (equal weight per AOI)

B7.rule: B-13 B7: Y3 = Brier of the constant (training-side flooded share per fold; the test share for the single-fold llmcut split) minus Brier of M1; Brier skill increment = delta BS / Brier of that constant

B1op.rule: B-13 B1: as B-12 B1 (true R set to r0 by proportional or constant shifts), adding the L rule (one-sided 95% upper limit of L+ below 0 and lower limit of L- above 0)

B1bc.rule: B-13 B1 (b)(c): stage 2 refitted in each replicate on the stage-2 design of the corrected code (world_v2_b8stage2_local, as B-11 B7); (b) location groups, (c) countries then activations within each drawn country (activation assigned to its majority country)

B1d.rule: B-13 B1 (d): variance of (c) (nested, refit) plus the Nadeau-Bengio variance over the 13 fold assignments of v47; normal approximation, one-sided 95%

B2.rule: B-13 B2: injected odds ratio whose mean gain reaches each interval's upper limit (in Brier units, upper R times the corrected run's yardstick) minus each no-effect reference, from the curves of v64; Monte Carlo ranges as in v59; estimator scale by the B-10 B11 curves (v68 B3 rule)
